inputs.text: [excited] GAL… ih… MY… mus. "Galli," in Latin, [serious] means rooster, chicken. And "mimus" means one who imitates. [curious] So what does that give us?
[chuckles] There you go, except it was much bigger than a chicken. [proud] It lived in Asia, in the Mongolian desert, seventy million years ago.
[curious] Is it a cousin of the raptors, [gasps] like Velociraptor?
[confident] A distant cousin, yes, [amazed] but this one didn't even have teeth — just a beak, like a bird.
